## 👁 Hide amounts

Every amount now shows as **`JOD •••`** until you tap the 👁 in the top bar, so a glance at your screen gives nothing away (#19). It's the same `•••` for any value, with no sign, on every screen: cards, lists, charts and their tooltips. Tap the eye again to hide them; they also hide again after 30 seconds in the background and every time you open the app. Forms still show the real number you're typing.

It's **on by default**, for existing users too. **Settings → Security → Hide amounts** turns it off.

## ➕ Quick add widget (Android)

A home-screen widget with **Expense**, **Income** and 🎤 buttons opens the add form, or voice entry, in one tap (#18). Long-press the app icon for the same three. With the app lock on, the PIN or fingerprint comes first, and the widget never shows any amounts. It follows dark mode and the phone's language.

## 🥧 Monthly Income vs Spending

A new chart on Home shows the income and spending of any month you pick, with a year and a month selector (#17).

## Fixes

- A long amount, like "Spent this year", no longer wraps and overflows its card on Home.

## Download
**Android**
- Also on **[F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/ace.software.pocketsense/)**, which keeps it updated. It ships these same signed APKs, so you can switch between the two and keep your data.
- **`PocketSense-v2.4.2-arm64-v8a.apk`**: almost all modern Android phones. Use this one if unsure.
- `PocketSense-v2.4.2-armeabi-v7a.apk`: older 32-bit phones
- `PocketSense-v2.4.2-x86_64.apk`: emulators and Chromebooks

Installs as an update over any earlier version and keeps your data.

**Linux (x86_64)**: pick one.
- **Debian, Ubuntu, Mint:** `PocketSense-v2.4.2-linux-x64.deb`
  ```sh
  sudo apt install ./PocketSense-v2.4.2-linux-x64.deb
  ```
- **Fedora, openSUSE:** `PocketSense-v2.4.2-linux-x64.rpm`
  ```sh
  sudo dnf install ./PocketSense-v2.4.2-linux-x64.rpm   # or: sudo zypper install
  ```
- **Any distro:** `PocketSense-v2.4.2-linux-x64.AppImage`. Make it executable and run it.
- **Any distro:** `PocketSense-v2.4.2-linux-x64.tar.gz`. Unpack it and run `./PocketSense/pocket_sense`.

All need glibc 2.35 or newer and a running keyring (GNOME Keyring or KWallet). With the AppImage or the tarball you also need GTK 3, and `parecord` for voice entry (`pulseaudio-utils` on Debian/Ubuntu/Fedora, `libpulse` on Arch).
